question: Is query normalization followed by first-row selection a complete repair, and what reconciliation must precede unambiguous name-based access?

criteria.instruction: Query-only normalization/first-row selection hides a mixed-index ownership collision. Inventory derived keys, block ambiguous name-based selection, obtain explicit owner reconciliation, and use one pinned rule for writes/lookups. Preserve stable-ID grants/history, original bytes and revision; update index only after ownership decisions.
Cite lookup journal and reconciliation or U4. Test returned IDs/permissions for composed/decomposed/plain/rejected-script cases, not only status or rendering.
Do not claim reconciliation or deployment is complete, or revoke/delete all ID-bound history merely because name-based access is ambiguous.
